ayahOccurrences.text: ثُمَّ أَنتُمْ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ تَقْتُلُونَ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَتُخْرِجُونَ فَرِيقًا مِّنكُم مِّن دِيَٰرِهِمْ تَظَٰهَرُونَ عَلَيْهِم بِٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْعُدْوَٰنِ وَإِن يَأْتُوكُمْ أُسَٰرَىٰ تُفَٰدُوهُمْ وَهُوَ مُحَرَّمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ إِخْرَاجُهُمْ ۚ أَفَتُؤْمِنُونَ بِبَعْضِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَتَكْفُرُونَ بِبَعْضٍ ۚ فَمَا جَزَآءُ مَن يَفْعَلُ ذَٰلِكَ مِنكُمْ إِلَّا خِزْىٌ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ يُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰٓ أَشَدِّ ٱلْعَذَابِ ۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ مُصَدِّقٌ لِّمَا مَعَهُمْ نَبَذَ فَرِيقٌ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ كِتَٰبَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَآءَ ظُهُورِهِمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

ayahOccurrences.text: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْأَهِلَّةِ ۖ قُلْ هِىَ مَوَٰقِيتُ لِلنَّاسِ وَٱلْحَجِّ ۗ وَلَيْسَ ٱلْبِرُّ بِأَن تَأْتُوا۟ ٱلْبُيُوتَ مِن ظُهُورِهَا وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلْبِرَّ مَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰ ۗ وَأْتُوا۟ ٱلْبُيُوتَ مِنْ أَبْوَٰبِهَا ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ

ayahOccurrences.text: قَدْ خَسِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً قَالُوا۟ يَٰحَسْرَتَنَا عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطْنَا فِيهَا وَهُمْ يَحْمِلُونَ أَوْزَارَهُمْ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِمْ ۚ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ

أظْهَرَ ʾaẓhara [v. IV] I [intrans.] to enter into the noontime, midday

(30:18) وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِى السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَعَشِيًّا وَحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ praise is due to Him everywhere [lit. in the heavens and on earth] all the time [lit. in the evening and at midday] II [trans.]

1 to cause to spread

(40:26) أَوْ أَنْ يُظْهِرَ فِى الأَرْضِ الْفَسَادَ or that he will cause disorder to spread in the land

2 to reveal to, to make known to, to divulge

(72:26) عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ فَلاَ يُظْهِرُ عَلَى غَيْبِهِ أَحَدًا the One who knows what is hidden–He reveals to none His secrets

3 to cause to prevail, to cause to overcome, to exalt

(48:28) هُوَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُ بِالْهُدَى وَدِينِ الْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُ عَلَى الدِّينِ كُلِّهِ it is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of Truth, that He may exalt it above every religion.

entries.label: ظاهَرَ
entries.definitionHtml:
ظاهَرَ ẓāhara [v. III] I [intrans.] [jur.] to perform ظِهَار ẓihār, i.e., to say to one’s wife (according to a pre‐Islamic practice) that her back is as forbidden to one as the back of one’s mother

(33:4) وَمَا جَعَلَ أَزْوَاجَكُمُ اللاَّئِي تُظَاهِرُونَ مِنْهُنَّ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ and He has not made your wives, whom you declare to be ‘unlawful to you as your mothers’ backs’, your [real] mothers II [trans.] to back up, to aid, to support

(9:4) وَلَمْ يُظَاهِرُوا عَلَيْكُمْ أَحَدًا and who have not supported anyone against you.

entries.label: ظاهِر
entries.definitionHtml:
ظاهِر ẓāhir [act. part.; fem. ظاهِرَةٌ ẓāhiratun; masc. pl.ظاهِرون ẓāhirūn]

1 manifest, clear‏

(31:20) وَأَسْبَغَ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعَمَهُ ظَاهِرَةً وَبَاطِنَةً and He has lavished upon you His bounties, apparent and hidden; *الظاهِر

(57:3) (an attribute of God) the Manifest, the Outer

2 outer surface, outer layer, appearance

(30:7) يَعْلَمُونَ ظَاهِرًا مِنَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا they know only the outer layer of this present life; *

(13:33) بِظَاهِرٍ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ by the literal meaning of speech, or, by just empty words [lit. by what is apparent of the words]

3 the outside

(57:13) بِسُورٍ لَهُ بَابٌ بَاطِنُهُ فِيهِ الرَّحْمَةُ وَظَاهِرُهُ مِنْ قِبَلِهِ الْعَذَابُ a ‏wall with a door in it, on the inside of it there is mercy, while on the outside, next to it, lies chastisement

4 visible, in sight

(34:18) وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ الْقُرَى الَّتِي بَارَكْنَا فِيهَا قُرًى ظَاهِرَةً and We set between them and the towns We had blessed, [other] towns within sight

5 eminent, prominent

(40:29) لَكُمُ الْمُلْكُ الْيَوْمَ ظَاهِرِينَ فِى الأَرْضِ to you is sovereignty today; eminent [you are] in the land

6 victorious, prevailing

(61:14) فَأَيَّدْنَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا عَلَى عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا ظَاهِرِينَ We supported those who believe against their enemy and they became victorious.

entries.label: ظَهَرَ
entries.definitionHtml:
ظَهَرَ ẓahara a I [v. intrans.]

1 to appear, to become evident, to become manifest

(30:41) ظَهَرَ الْفَسَادُ فِى الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ corruption has appeared on land and sea

2 to be open, to be manifest

(6:151) وَلاَ تَقْرَبُوا الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ and do not approach indecent deeds, be they open or secret

3 to triumph, to spread out

(9:48) حَتَّى جَاءَ الْحَقُّ وَظَهَرَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ until the truth came and God’s command triumphed

4 to show

(24:31) وَلاَ يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلاَّ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا and should not flaunt their charms beyond those of them that may [unavoidably/decently] show

5 [with prep. عَلَي] a) to ascend

(43:33) وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ and staircases upon which they ascend b) to prevail over, to get the upper hand over

(9:8) إِنْ يَظْهَرُوا عَلَيْكُمْ لاَ يَرْقُبُوا فِيكُمْ إِلا وَلاَ ذِمَّةً if they get the upper hand over you, they would not respect any tie with you, of kinship or treaty c) to come to know, to become cognisant of

(24:31) أَوِ التَّابِعِينَ غَيْرِ أُولِي الإِرْبَةِ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ أَوِ الطِّفْلِ الَّذِينَ لَمْ يَظْهَرُوا عَلَى عَوْرَاتِ النِّسَاءِ or such men as attend them who have no sexual desire or children who are not yet aware of women’s nakedness d) to discover, to find out, to come upon

(9:8) إِنْ يَظْهَرُوا عَلَيْكُمْ يَرْجُمُوكُمْ أَوْ يُعِيدُوكُمْ فِى مِلَّتِهِمْ if they discover you they would stone you or force you to return to their religion II [v. trans.] to climb on the back of, to scale

(18:97) فَمَا اسْطَاعُوا أَنْ يَظْهَرُوهُ so they could not scale it.

entries.label: ظَهْر
entries.definitionHtml:
ظَهْر ẓahr [n.; pl. ظُهُور ẓuhūr]

1 back

(9:35) فَتُكْوَى بِهَا جِبَاهُهُمْ وَجُنُوبُهُمْ وَظُهُورُهُمْ and their foreheads, sides and backs will be branded by them; *

(6:138) وَأَنْعَامٌ حُرِّمَتْ ظُهُورُهَا and animals which are exempt from labour [lit. and animals whose backs are forbidden]; *

(94:3) الَّذِي أَنْقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ that which strained your back/troubled you [lit. caused your back to break]; *

(3:187) فَنَبَذُوهُ وَرَاءَ ظُهُورِهِمْ they neglected it, they held it in contempt [lit. they cast it behind their backs]

2 back side, back door

(2:189) وَلَيْسَ الْبِرُّ بِأَنْ تَأْتُوا الْبُيُوتَ مِنْ ظُهُورِهَا it is not righteousness that you enter houses by their back doors

3 after, behind

(6:94) وَلَقَدْ جِئْتُمُونَا فُرَادَى كَمَا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَتَرَكْتُمْ مَا خَوَّلْنَاكُمْ وَرَاءَ ظُهُورِكُمْ now you return to Us, alone, [just] as We first created you–and you have left behind what We gave you

4 deck of a ship

(43:12–13) وَجَعَلَ‏ ‏لَكُمْ‏ ‏مِنَ‏ ‏الْفُلْكِ‏ ‏وَالأَنْعَامِ‏ ‏مَا‏ ‏تَرْكَبُون لِتَسْتَوُوا‏ ‏عَلَى‏ ‏ظُهُورِهِ ‏‏who made for you ships and animals to ride on so that you may remember your Lord’s grace when you are seated on their boards/backs

5 surface

(42:33) إِنْ يَشَأْ يُسْكِنِ الرِّيحَ فَيَظْلَلْنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَى ظَهْرِهِ if He wills, He stills the wind, so they would stay motionless on its [the sea’s] surface [lit. back]

6 loins

(7:172) وَإِذْ أَخَذَ رَبُّكَ مِنْ بَنِي ءَادَمَ مِنْ ظُهُورِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ and [remember] when your Lord took from the children of Adam, from their loins, their seed.

entries.label: ظِهْرِيَّاٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
ظِهْرِيَّاٌ ẓihriyyan [adverbial] at the back, in the back, behind, neglected and forgotten

(11:92) وَاتَّخَذْتُمُوهُ وَرَاءَكُمْ ظِهْرِيًّا and you have turned your backs on Him, forgotten.
